hook_text: South Africa counted 62 027 503 people. Can you say that number out loud without stumbling?
clip_script: The 2022 census counted 62 027 503 people. Long number? Split it into groups of three from the right: 62, then 027, then 503. Now read: sixty-two million, twenty-seven thousand, five hundred and three. Easy. Every digit has a seat. The 6 sits in the ten millions seat, so it is worth 60 000 000. The Sun is 149 600 000 km away: 100 000 000 plus 40 000 000 plus 9 000 000 plus 600 000. And zeros? They hold empty seats. Three hundred and five million, forty thousand and nine is 305 040 009. Every digit has a seat.
visual_style: A nine-column place value table filling digit by digit, with the groups of three glowing in turn and seat labels popping up above each digit.
mood: Confident and curious, like cracking a code.
pacing: Quick split into groups, a beat on each group as it is read, then the zeros dropping into their seats.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write the distance to the Sun in words.
